note: Light presets (docs/light/PLAN.md). Directions are given in image terms for the front camera; the subject never changes, so the light is the only variable.

pattern.ja: 投影・ボリュームライト

forms.setting: standing on a seamless dark charcoal studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: an orange-gelled light at 60 degrees to image-left and a teal-gelled light at 60 degrees to image-right, the two colours wrapping the two sides of the mannequin and the sphere and blending to a muted tone at the centre
forms.keep: orange gel from image-left, teal gel from image-right, blending at the centre

forms.setting: standing on a seamless dark charcoal studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: one deep red-gelled hard light from 45 degrees image-left, the whole lit side saturated red, the shadow side black, intense moody look
forms.keep: single deep red hard light from 45 degrees image-left, shadow side black

forms.setting: standing on a seamless dark charcoal studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: a soft violet light from above-left and a soft blue light from low image-right, the backdrop washed with a violet-to-blue gradient
forms.keep: soft violet from above-left, soft blue from low right, violet-to-blue backdrop gradient

forms.setting: standing in an empty dark warehouse with light haze in the air, a high window at image-left
forms.desc: visible parallel beams of sunlight slanting down through the haze from a high window at image-left, one beam falling across the mannequin, dust in the beams, the rest dim
forms.keep: visible slanting light beams through haze from a high window image-left, one beam on the figure

forms.setting: standing in thick fog on open ground
forms.desc: a single strong light far behind the mannequin glowing through thick fog, the mannequin a soft grey silhouette against a bright glowing haze, light scattering around the outline
forms.keep: strong light behind glowing through thick fog, soft silhouette, scattered outline glow

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: a hard warm light from 45 degrees image-left projecting a sharp shadow of a four-pane window frame across the mannequin, the sphere and the backdrop
forms.keep: hard warm light from image-left projecting a four-pane window shadow across figure and backdrop

forms.setting: standing on a seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor
forms.desc: a hard warm light from 45 degrees image-left through a branch of leaves out of frame, projecting sharp leaf shadows across the mannequin, the sphere and the backdrop
forms.keep: hard warm light from image-left projecting leaf shadows across figure and backdrop

forms.setting: standing on a seamless dark charcoal studio backdrop and floor, light haze in the air
forms.desc: many small round spots of coloured light (pink, blue, yellow, green) scattered across the mannequin, the sphere, the floor and the backdrop as if from a mirror ball out of frame, dim ambient light
forms.keep: many small coloured light spots scattered across figure, sphere, floor and backdrop, dim ambient
